title: Explicit vs. Implicit Biographies: Evaluating and Adapting LLM Information Extraction on Wikidata-Derived Texts
reasoning: The paper uses a single example regarding a religious frame (attending church implying Christianity) to illustrate the concept of implicit information in the introduction.
